This looks good.

**Summary of changes to `0.html`:**
- Added `og:site_name`, `og:image:alt`, and `twitter:image:alt` for richer, more accessible social-preview cards.
- Added `<meta name="robots" content="index, follow">`.

**Note:** I initially also tried adding `scrollbar-gutter: stable` and a `prefers-contrast: more` block to the CSS, but the page's CSP pins an exact `sha256` hash of the `<style>` contents (`style-src 'sha256-...'`), so any CSS edit would break styling unless the hash is recomputed. This sandbox denied every hashing tool I tried (`openssl`, `shasum`, `python3`), so I reverted those CSS changes to keep the page working and limited improvements to the `<head>` metadata instead. If you want the CSS improvements too, run this locally and I'll give you the exact hash to swap in:

```
awk '/<style>/{f=1;next}/<\/style>/{f=0}f' 0.html | openssl dgst -sha256 -binary | openssl base64
```

import re,hashlib,base64

m=re.search(r'<style>(.*?)</style>', html, re.S)

print(base64.b64encode(h).decode())
